# Manage local work items

Use when work must be planned or tracked without a remote issue service.

## Procedure

1. Use a lowercase slug and create with `tasktra work-item --root <root> create <id> <title>`. Add the governing goal, bounded body, and useful labels.
2. Use `list` for summaries and `show <id>` only when the full body is needed.
3. Before updating, read the current item and pass its exact version with `update --expected-version <n>`. On conflict, reread and reconcile; never overwrite.
4. Keep local work-item paths project-scoped. Stop on traversal, junction, symlink, malformed frontmatter, or size-limit errors.
5. Do not move an implementation item to `done` from a bare status request. Create a matching workflow with `tasktra workflow create --goal-id <goal> --work-unit-id <item>` and save its `workflow` object. Accept each validated handoff with `tasktra workflow accept <workflow-path> <handoff-path>`, replacing the saved state with its returned `workflow` object, then verify it with `tasktra workflow validate <workflow-path>`. Pass that completed workflow file to `tasktra work-item --root <root> update <id> --expected-version <n> --status done --workflow <workflow-path>`.

Return the item ID, new version, status, goal link, and any conflict or workflow gate still pending.
